NEW ROOF INSTALLATION

Build the right roof into the plan.

New construction calls for coordination between the roof design, supporting structure, chosen materials, and other trades. Establish the roofing scope early so transitions and penetrations receive proper attention.

WHAT TO CONSIDER

Coordinate before installation

Discuss roof pitch, loads, drainage, ventilation, and material requirements with the project team. Confirm which party handles permits, inspections, delivery access, and protection of completed work.

When to start a conversation

  • New residential construction
  • Commercial construction
  • Additions
  • Coordinating an installation schedule

A PRACTICAL PATH FORWARD

01

Discuss the property

Share the roof type, your location, and what you have noticed. Gather previous repair records if available.

02

Assess the scope

Ask how the findings support the proposed new roof installation work and which components are included.

03

Agree on the plan

Review the written estimate, access, scheduling, change approvals, cleanup, and applicable warranty terms.

Questions worth asking.

What affects the cost of new roof installation?

Discuss roof pitch, loads, drainage, ventilation, and material requirements with the project team. Confirm which party handles permits, inspections, delivery access, and protection of completed work. The size, access, existing condition, product choice, and complete scope affect the estimate. Request a property-specific written quote.

Will the work be covered by warranty?

The company mentions warranties but does not publish complete terms. Ask which workmanship and manufacturer warranties apply to your proposed work, including exclusions, transfer provisions, and maintenance requirements.

Do you offer financing?

The existing website advertises financing. Contact the company for current availability, the application process, eligibility, and written terms. No rates or approval guarantees are published here.
